name: Deep collection misrouting in nested branches
description: Inside a loop over a collection or implicit grid (e.g., rendering pixels into an array), introduce nested branches that occasionally write to the wrong index while still using legal in-bounds indices. The resulting collection has all elements filled, but their logical positions are swapped, duplicated, or shifted, causing test assertions on expected layout to fail.

trigger_conditions.test_shape: Tests that build an expected array representation (thumbnail, histogram, buffer) and compare it element-wise against the method output.
trigger_conditions.input_properties: Dimensions and input data should cause both branches (even/odd indices, middle positions) to be exercised.

example.description: A 2D-to-1D rendering loop fills an output pixel buffer. Nested branches misroute writes to a different in-bounds index (row-wise pair-swap on even rows, row-wise rotate on odd rows). The buffer is fully populated, but logical positions are swapped/shifted, causing element-wise layout assertions to fail.
